entries.reason: All 32 cases assert exact file existence/content of a production tests/android-os/** native Capacitor+emulator harness (workspace package.json, verify-safety.mjs signing-credential scan strings, main.ts observer wiring) and an exact codemagic.yaml android-os-resume-test workflow block (instance type, artifact globs, absence of signing/publishing sections). Reconstructing that native harness scaffold or a parallel deployment-workflow YAML purely to satisfy this guard would itself violate the lab boundary (no native app signing configuration, no deployment workflows). capacitorUpgradeSafety.local.test.tsx covers the adjacent but distinct Capacitor runtime-upgrade-version concern; it does not represent these file/workflow-specific assertions.

All 41 cases assert exact file existence/content of a production tests/ios-os/** native Capacitor+Appium Simulator harness (workspace package.json, verify-safety.mjs signing-credential scan strings, main.ts observer/state-contract wiring, resume.e2e.mjs assertion text) and an exact codemagic.yaml ios-os-resume-test workflow block (mac_mini_m2 instance, artifact globs, absence of signing/publishing sections). Reconstructing that native harness scaffold or a parallel deployment-workflow YAML purely to satisfy this guard would itself violate the lab boundary (no native app signing configuration, no deployment workflows). capacitorUpgradeSafety.local.test.tsx covers the adjacent but distinct Capacitor runtime-upgrade-version concern; it does not represent these file/workflow-specific assertions.

Requires an iOS device/simulator, native lifecycle callbacks, and signed native runtime; the isolated browser lab has no iOS execution domain. The mapped test covers only the portable fail-closed lifecycle policy.

Of 37 expanded cases: 1 (Vault destructive authority) and 28 (team_messages/events/photos role matrices, 4x7) are ported with exact-match verification against the final active Postgres policy/function text. The remaining 8 (7 club_messages send/read cases + the club_messages portion of the cross-club outsider case) depend on a club_messages SELECT policy and a has_role-gated INSERT branch for league_admin that do not exist anywhere in the exported migration corpus; the extracted INSERT policy text has no branch admitting a bare league_admin role at all, yet the bundle test expects league_admin to succeed unconditionally alongside every other role - a confirmed, irreducible contradiction, not merely an absent definition.
